question.prompt:
Problems \(17,\) \(18,\) and \(19\) refer to the following:

Cookies For a Crowd

At Central Middle School the \(108\) students who take the AMC \(8\) meet in the evening to talk about problems and eat an average of two cookies apiece. Walter and Gretel are baking Bonnie’s Best Bar Cookies this year. Their recipe, which makes a pan of \(15\) cookies, lists these items: \(1\dfrac{1}{2}\) cups of flour, \(2\) eggs, \(3\) tablespoons butter, \(\dfrac{3}{4}\) cups sugar, and \(1\) package of chocolate drops. They will make only full recipes, not partial recipes.

The drummer gets sick. The concert is cancelled. Walter and Gretel must make enough pans of cookies to supply \(216\) cookies. There are \(8\) tablespoons in a stick of butter. How many sticks of butter will be needed? (Some butter may be left over, of course.)

solutions.explanation:
First find how many full recipes are needed, because the butter must cover those complete recipes. Fourteen pans make \(14\cdot15=210\) cookies, which is too few. Fifteen pans make \(225\) cookies, so they need \(15\) recipes.

Each recipe uses \(3\) tablespoons of butter, giving a total of
\[
15\cdot3=45\text{ tablespoons}.
\]
Five sticks supply only \(5\cdot8=40\) tablespoons, while six supply \(6\cdot8=48\). Therefore they need \(\boxed{6}\) sticks of butter, choice \(\text{B}\).
solutions.title: Count full pans, then full sticks
